visit.title: Your Visit
visit.pick: Pick a time and bring the item with you. Nothing happens to it until you have agreed what should.
visit.nothingFree: Nothing free at {location} in the next {days} days.
visit.unavailable: That time is no longer free. Pick another one below — the list has just been refreshed.

booked.title: Visit booked
booked.emailLine: A confirmation is on its way by email.

before.verified: Verified — nothing to bring but the item.
before.sign: Sign the loan and custody agreements.
before.moneyFollows: The money follows once you have signed.
before.inPerson: Or verify in person when you arrive.

visit.rules: Move or cancel any time before the slot. Miss it, and we close the visit — the case stays open.
visit.moved: This case changed while you had it open. Nothing was done — the page now shows where it stands.

ceremony.noTokenMessage: Open the link our staff sent you, exactly as it was given to you.
ceremony.loadFailedTitle: We could not open your documents
ceremony.documentFailed: This document could not be displayed. Please ask our staff.
ceremony.emptyPacketTitle: There is nothing here to sign
ceremony.emptyPacketMessage: Please tell the member of staff with you — these documents were not prepared properly.
ceremony.disclosureFallback: You are about to review and sign documents electronically. Ask the member of staff with you if you would rather not.
ceremony.packetExpiry: These documents can be signed until {when}.
ceremony.declineConfirmMessage: This withdraws every document prepared for today — the whole set, not one of them. Nothing will be signed, and the member of staff with you can take it from there.
ceremony.declineReasonLabel: Tell us why, if you like (optional — this stays on this screen and is not stored)
ceremony.declinedMessage: The documents were withdrawn and your signing link is no longer valid. The member of staff with you can help with what happens next.
ceremony.rosterLabel: What you are signing today: {total} documents
ceremony.movedOn: You have signed the {signed}. Next is the {next}.
ceremony.pageNoText: This page is a scan, so there is no text on it to read out. Ask the member of staff with you to read it to you before you sign.
ceremony.pageFailed: This page could not be shown. Do not sign until it has — ask the member of staff with you.
ceremony.integrityWarning: This document does not match what we prepared. Stop and tell our staff before signing.
ceremony.consentLabel: I have read the {title} and agree to sign it
ceremony.signatureTypedNameLabel: Type your name here to sign
ceremony.signatureTypedFailed: This device could not turn what you typed into a signature. Ask the member of staff with you.
ceremony.fullNameLabel: Your name, exactly as printed on the ID you showed us
ceremony.heldNameHint: The name these documents were prepared under.
ceremony.postalAddressHint: Used only to send you written notice.
ceremony.missingPages: Please read every page before signing.
ceremony.missingConsent: Please tick the box to confirm you have read it.
ceremony.missingSignature: Please sign in the box above.
ceremony.missingName: Please type your name as it appears on your ID.
ceremony.signUnconfirmed: We did not hear back after your signature was sent, so we cannot yet say whether it was recorded. Do not sign again — check what happened instead.
ceremony.sealedMessage: Your signed copies are on your case page. Keep the fingerprint below — it identifies this exact set of documents.
ceremony.downloadFailed: The download could not be completed. Your signed copies are on your case page, and the member of staff with you can print them at the counter.
ceremony.downloadExpiry: You can download from this screen until {when}. After that, the member of staff with you can print your copies at the counter.
ceremony.sealedIntegrityWarning: The copy that downloaded does not match the fingerprint of what you signed, so it has not been saved. Your signature is recorded — ask the member of staff with you for a printed copy.
ceremony.signedMessage: Others still have to sign before these documents are sealed.

TOKEN_INVALID.title: This signing link is not valid
TOKEN_INVALID.message: Ask the member of staff with you to open a new signing link.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: This signing link has expired
TOKEN_EXPIRED.message: Signing links last a short while for your safety. Ask for a new one.

TOKEN_CONSUMED.title: This signing session is finished
TOKEN_CONSUMED.message: If you have just signed, nothing more is needed — your signed copies are on your case page and the member of staff with you can print them. Otherwise this link has been used already; ask for a new one.

TOKEN_CONFLICT.title: This link was opened on another device
TOKEN_CONFLICT.message: A signing link stays on the device it was first opened on. Ask for a new link for this device.

PACKET_VOIDED.title: These documents were withdrawn
PACKET_VOIDED.message: A newer set replaced them. Ask for the link to the current documents.

PACKET_EXPIRED.title: These documents have expired
PACKET_EXPIRED.message: They were prepared too long ago to sign now. Ask for them to be prepared again.

PACKET_COMPLETED.title: These documents are already signed
PACKET_COMPLETED.message: Everyone who had to sign has signed. You can close this page.

DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.title: That document is not part of this signing
DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.message: Reload the page to see the documents you were asked to sign.

DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed that one
DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Reload the page to carry on with whatever is still left to sign.

PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.title: Please read every page first
PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.message: Move through the whole document, then sign.

PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: That page is not in this document
PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: Reload the page and read the document through again.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please confirm you agree first
CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Tick the box confirming you have read the document and agree to sign it.

ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please agree to sign electronically first
ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Read the notice about signing electronically and agree to it before signing anything.

KYC_REQUIRED.title: Your identity check is not recorded yet
KYC_REQUIRED.message: The member of staff with you needs to record your ID check before you sign.

IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name on your ID
IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.message: Type your name exactly as it appears on the ID the member of staff with you checked. If the ID is in another name, they need to record the check again.

SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.title: It is not your turn yet
SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.message: Someone else has to sign these documents before you do.

SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed everything
SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Nothing further is needed from you. You can close this page.

SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name you started signing under
SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.message: Everything in this session is signed under one name. Use the name on your earlier signature, or ask for a fresh set of documents.

POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.title: Your postal address is needed
POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.message: Type it on the postal address line, then sign.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: That signature could not be read
SIGNATURE_INVALID.message: Clear the signature box and sign again.

SOURCE_MISSING.title: The document could not be loaded
SOURCE_MISSING.message: Ask the member of staff with you to prepare it again.

SOURCE_TAMPERED.title: The document does not match what was prepared
SOURCE_TAMPERED.message: Do not sign. Ask the member of staff with you to prepare it again.

FONT_MISSING.title: The document cannot be drawn right now
FONT_MISSING.message: Nothing has been signed. Ask the member of staff with you; the shop has to restore its document font first.

CONFLICT.title: This signing was finished elsewhere
CONFLICT.message: Another device completed or withdrew it while this page was open.
